answer: Cap every enclave's trust share in inverse proportion to its electrical resistance from audited roots, isolating each sparse lagoon of fake accounts. Each participant locks escrow and signs an audit proof with a commit hash keyed to a random beacon for >=3 epochs. Islands past a 4% resistance threshold earn <2% jade payout weight, while fake bridges supplying one lotus cluster slash staked bonds. One honest node pays 40 POA once; faking 200 bots locks 8000 POA to earn at most 60 POA, a net loss. This fails if audited roots secretly sell shortcut edges.
